B. Configuring Web Application Firewall (WAF) in the system to ensure architecture security.
C. Using Storage Disaster Recovery Service (SDRS) to prevent data loss.
D. Purchasing ModelArts for AI-based system data analysis.

questions.prompt: System performance affects user experience and needs to be considered at the beginning of the architecture design process. Which of the following statements are true about performance during architecture design?

D. During system design, the requirement on product performance may change with service adjustment.

questions.prompt: Cloud Backup and Recovery (CBR) lets you back up Elastic Cloud Servers (ECSs) and Elastic Volume Service (EVS) disks with ease. Which of the following statements are true about the two types of backups (Cloud server backup vs cloud disk backup)?

B. Advantage: Cloud server backup backs up all disks of a server at the same time to avoid data inconsistencies; cloud disk backup ensures data security inexpensively.
C. Backup speed: Cloud server backup is fast; cloud disk backup is slow.
D. Backup/restore object: Cloud server backup backs up all disks on cloud servers; cloud disk backup allows for backup of one or more specific disks on cloud servers.
